tagline: 理光便携相机，1985 年发布
description: 理光于1985年推出的便携相机。配备Rikenon Lens 35mm f/3.5, 4 elements in 3 groups。快门速度Programmed, 1/30 ~ 1/500 sec.。感光度ISO 100 / 200 / 400 / 1000 by DX-code system plus manual selector for non-DX film。Single-point active autofocusing system。

specs.镜头: Rikenon Lens 35mm f/3.5, 4 elements in 3 groups
specs.取景器: Albada type, bright-frame, 0.47X, field of view 84%
specs.感光度: ISO 100 / 200 / 400 / 1000 by DX-code system plus manual selector for non-DX film
specs.英文简介: The AF-50 is an autofocus point-and-shoot camera for 35mm film, introduced by Japanese manufacturer Ricoh in 1985.
